result.instructions: Tools for Docsumo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which documents are still being processed in Docsumo?"; "Show me the extracted fields of the latest invoice."; "List the cases in our onboarding agent that are waiting for approval.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Docsumo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run docsumo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run docsumo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run docsumo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. docsumo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: docsumo_get_account
tools.title: Get account and document types
tools.description: Return the account details and the document types enabled for this API key. Use the document type slugs when you list or upload documents.

tools.name: docsumo_get_documents_summary
tools.title: Get documents summary
tools.description: Return counts of the account's documents grouped by processing status.

tools.name: docsumo_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the account's documents. Filter by view (files, folder, all_files), folder, document type, status, title text or creation date. Page with limit (max 20) and offset.

view.description: files = outside folders; folder = inside folder_id (needs folder_id); all_files = everything.

folder_id.description: Folder id. Required when view is folder.

doc_type.description: Document type slug, as listed by docsumo_get_account.

q.description: Partial match on the document title.

created_date.description: Creation date filter, e.g. gte:2026-01-01&lte:2026-01-31 (operators gte and lte, YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: docsumo_get_document
tools.title: Get document details
tools.description: Return the details of one document: title, type, status, folder and timestamps.

doc_id.description: Document id, as returned by docsumo_list_documents.

tools.name: docsumo_get_extracted_data
tools.title: Get extracted data
tools.description: Return the simplified extracted fields of one document. While Docsumo is still processing the document, the tool says so and returns no fields; call it again later.

doc_id.description: Document id, as returned by docsumo_list_documents.

tools.name: docsumo_get_review_url
tools.title: Get document review URL
tools.description: Return the review page URL of one document. Set signed_url to true for a shareable link with a limited lifetime; the link lets anyone open the review page.

doc_id.description: Document id, as returned by docsumo_list_documents.

signed_url.description: true = a shareable signed link valid for a limited time.

tools.name: docsumo_get_folder_review_url
tools.title: Get folder review URL
tools.description: Return the review page URL of one folder (signed for sharing).

tools.name: docsumo_upload_document_from_url
tools.title: Upload document from URL
tools.description: Upload one file from a public URL into the account and start processing it. Creates a new document and uses the account's document quota; it does not replace or merge anything. Check the document type with docsumo_get_account first.

file_url.description: Public URL of a JPG, PNG, TIFF or PDF file.

type.description: Document type slug, as listed by docsumo_get_account.

user_doc_id.description: Your own id for the document, for tracking.

review_token.description: true = also return a shareable review URL.

tools.name: docsumo_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List the account's agents (case types and document agents). Pass the id of a case type to the case tools.

tools.name: docsumo_get_agent
tools.title: Get case type details
tools.description: Return one case type (agent): its stages, fields and document types.

casetype_id.description: Case type (agent) id, as returned by docsumo_list_agents.

tools.name: docsumo_list_cases
tools.title: List cases
tools.description: List the cases of one case type, newest first by default. Filter by stage, assignee, workflow state, and created or modified date (DD/MM/YYYY). Page with limit (max 100) and offset.

casetype_id.description: Case type (agent) id, as returned by docsumo_list_agents.

stage_id.description: Keep cases in any of these stage ids.

assigned_to.description: Keep cases assigned to any of these user ids.

workflow_state.description: Keep cases in any of these workflow states.

tools.name: docsumo_get_case
tools.title: Get case overview
tools.description: Return one case. Add include to also return related sections: doctypes, fields, approvals, exports or documents.

casetype_id.description: Case type (agent) id, as returned by docsumo_list_agents.

case_id.description: Case id, as returned by docsumo_list_cases.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Docsumo
prompts.description: What you can do with Docsumo here, with example requests to try.
